findings.title: Missing React `key` on GrafanaRuleListItem in list map
findings.body: In the `rules.map(...)` render, the `grafana` branch renders `<GrafanaRuleListItem ...>` without a `key` prop, while all other branches pass `key={key}`. The previous `GrafanaRuleLoader` usage had `key={key}`. This triggers React key warnings and, more importantly, causes element identity to be positional, which can lead to incorrect re-use/reset of component state as new pages of results are appended during infinite scrolling.

findings.title: Delete and Pause menu items are unreachable in the list view
findings.body: The menu now computes `canDelete`/`canPause` from either ruler or Grafana Prometheus abilities, but the rendering still requires a ruler rule: Delete is gated on `canDelete && rulerRule` and Pause on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. Since the whole point of this PR is that the list view no longer fetches ruler rules (`rulerRule` is undefined there), users will never see Delete or Pause in the rule list, even with full permissions — a functional regression for the new list view.

findings.title: Silence menu item does nothing without a ruler rule
findings.body: `AlertRuleMenu` can now enable the 'Silence notifications' item based solely on Grafana Prometheus abilities, but the drawer is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. In the list view `rule` (ruler rule) is undefined, so clicking Silence sets state but no drawer is shown — a dead UI action.

findings.title: Federated rule-group check removed, allowing edits/deletes of federated groups
findings.body: `useAllRulerRuleAbilities` (which now backs the deprecated `useAllAlertRuleAbilities`) hardcodes `const isFederated = false` and the former `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` call was deleted. Federated Mimir rule groups were previously treated as immutable (Update/Delete/Pause unsupported). Now the UI will offer edit/delete for federated groups, which will either corrupt or fail against the ruler. This is a behaviour regression for all existing consumers of `useAllAlertRuleAbilities`.

findings.title: Grafana recording rules lose Pause/Export abilities in the prom-based hook
findings.body: In `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, `Pause`, `Restore`, `DeletePermanently` and `ModifyExport` are gated on `isAlertingRule = prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`. The ruler equivalent used `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(...)`, which is true for Grafana recording rules as well. As a result, Grafana-managed recording rules can no longer be paused or exported from the list view, although the backend supports both.

findings.title: `returnTo` dropped from rule view link
findings.body: The removed `GrafanaRuleLoader` built the href as `createRelativeUrl('/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view', { returnTo })` using `createReturnTo()`. The new component drops the `returnTo` query param, so navigating back from the rule detail view will no longer return the user to their filtered list position.

findings.title: Silent empty render when Prometheus returns no matching group
findings.body: `promResponse.data.groups.at(0)?.rules.map(...)` renders nothing if the response contains no groups (e.g. group not yet propagated or wrong folder/group). Previously the ruler response provided a fallback and 'Creating' operation items. Users now see an empty group with no explanation or error.

findings.title: Removed coverage for rule matching and creating/deleting states without replacement
findings.body: This diff deletes all `matchRules` unit tests plus the 'creating' (ruler-only) and 'deleting' (prom-only) rendering tests, and replaces them with assertions about the More button/menu. The eventual-consistency behaviour that the component still conceptually supports (`RuleOperation` prop on `GrafanaRuleListItem`) is now completely untested, and no test covers the new ability resolution via `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` for recording rules or provisioned rules.
